catalog_entry.description: Join a song or sound to a video. The picture and its frame rate stay the same, and the new sound replaces the old. The result is as long as the video. A longer sound is cut off when the picture ends; a shorter one ends early and the picture plays on in silence. The sound keeps its own sample rate and channels.
